name: volatility
description: Advanced memory forensics framework for incident response and malware analysis

vol.description: Extract digital artifacts from volatile memory (RAM) dumps for forensic analysis
vol.usage:
vol -f memory.dmp imageinfo
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 pslist
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 netscan
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 malfind
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 hashdump
